title: How education and career break can shape your future

blocks.html: Paulina took a break during her last year of high school, when she was 19 and went alone to India, Nepal, and the Himalayas. Then, being 20 years old 1st-year university student, her daughter was born. The start of her higher education and professional life was interspersed with different events…and career breaks. Today, she strongly believes that those breaks made her stronger and made her who she is now. At work and in life.
